epics.title: Containerized Multi-Service Runtime Deployment & Health Probing
epics.jtbd: When an operator or automated testing pipeline clones the repository, I want a root docker-compose configuration defining the full application runtime stack and health endpoint exposure, so that the knowledge base and assistant can be reliably launched and observed in real environments.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Zero deployment startup failures (100% successful container launch rate)
epics.tocConstraintRef: Absence of root docker-compose execution manifest blocking runtime orchestration
requirements: R1: Root docker-compose.yml specification orchestrating FastAPI application service and dependencies
R2: Container health check configuration exposing and verifying /api/v1/health endpoint readiness

slices.title: Add root docker-compose specification with automated health checks
slices.jtbd: When deploying the service stack for this epic, I want a declarative docker-compose.yml at the repository root binding the API service and health checks, so that the running product can be launched and verified in real environments.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a fresh clone of the repository without previous runtime configuration
When docker compose up -d is invoked at the repository root
Then the crie-assistant service container starts and exposes port 8097
Given the running crie-assistant container
When the Docker health check queries http://localhost:8097/api/v1/health
Then the container status transitions to healthy with HTTP 200
slices.tocConstraintRef: Missing container composition descriptor at repository root
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Container build and initialization pass rate = 100%

epics.title: Runtime Observation & Launch Failure Remediation
epics.jtbd: When an automated verification harness executes post-clone runtime inspection, I want root docker-compose assets present and immediately discoverable, so that the runtime observation gate passes without launcher file-not-found errors.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Zero runtime launcher observation errors on post-clone verification
epics.tocConstraintRef: Runtime launcher failure due to missing docker-compose.yml file at repository root
requirements: R1: Ensure docker-compose.yml is committed directly at repository root to eliminate launcher observation defects
R2: Verify containerized runtime startup and /api/v1/health response pass automated launcher health probes

slices.title: Commit root docker-compose file and verify runtime observation probe
slices.jtbd: When resolving the recorded launcher defect for this epic, I want the root docker-compose file verified against automated inspection probes, so that runtime observation confirms a healthy service state.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the automated launcher inspecting the repository root after clone
When checking for the existence of docker-compose.yml
Then the file is detected at repo root and observation proceeds without error
Given the launched service under test
When querying the /api/v1/health endpoint
Then response status returns 200 with service healthy payload
slices.tocConstraintRef: Automated launcher failure from missing root docker-compose.yml
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Defect recurrence rate = 0% on post-clone launch probe
